No independent web source documents this temple — the generic name has no verifiable web footprint and identity is UNCERTAIN/PROVISIONAL (thin placeholder). It is not the well-documented Shree Hanuman Thakur (Mahabali) temple at Imphal, which is a distinct, 18th-century Ramanandi shrine. Nothing is known of its founding date, size, or managing body. town_description: Kakching Khunou is a town in Kakching district, Manipur, about 44 km southeast of Imphal. It lies in the heart of Manipur's garden belt, close to the Kakching Garden tourist site, and is a predominantly Meitei locality where Vaishnavite Hindu temples sit alongside indigenous Sanamahism traditions.

travel.airport: Bir Tikendrajit International Airport, Imphal (~44 km)
travel.railway: Nearest major railhead is Dimapur (Nagaland), ~200 km; the nearest in-state station is Jiribam.
travel.road: Kakching Khunou lies on the Kakching road network off NH-102 (Imphal-Moreh highway), about 44 km from Imphal; buses and shared taxis run from Imphal and Kakching town.
